searchText: How do VCs get the `signing_root` for an attestation? The computation requires state access (https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.0.0/specs/phase0/validator.md#aggregate-signature), and the BN's attestation production endpoint doesn't return `signing_root` (https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/#/ValidatorRequiredApi/produceAttestationData) You don't need much state, just the epoch and the for schedule. You can fetch them from other bits of the API. (*and genesis validators root) Gotcha! Thanks!
